subject: Post-call recap & next steps — SOC 2, audit logs, retention (Redwood + Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — SOC 2, audit logs, retention (Redwood + Acme Health)

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Key pain points you shared:
- Need auditable access and activity logs for model usage tied to user IDs and tokens (compliance + internal audits).
- Retention policy requirements: 7+ years for certain logs (healthcare/regulatory) but looking for flexible retention/archival options.
- Data residency and encryption assurances for PHI-sensitive payloads.
- DPA review and pen-test evidence required before procurement sign-off.

Goals discussed:
- Validate Redwood's SOC 2 posture and supporting artifacts (report, pen test summary, audit logs/export).
- Confirm retention and deletion policies + ways to export/handover logs.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with your security engineering team next week.

What Redwood will provide (action items we committed to):
1) Share our current SOC 2 Type II report and a short pen-test summary (attached).
2) Outline default audit-log retention and options for long-term retention/archival (attached retention summary).
3) Share a DPA template for your legal/security team to review (attached).
4) Set up a technical call with our security and infra leads — suggested times below.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Today: I'll send the SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, retention doc, and DPA for review (attached).
- Tue/Wed next week: 60-minute technical deep-dive with your security engineers (we're proposing Tue 4/13 10:30–11:30 AM PT or Wed 4/14 2:00–3:00 PM PT).
- After technical call: Narrow outstanding gaps and include in mutual action plan; legal teams to iterate on DPA.

Attachments included in this email: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report), retention_policy_summary.pdf, redwood_dpa_v1.docx (DPA template).

If you prefer we can also share a redacted pen-test report and provide temporary read-only access to a logs export for a sample timeframe.

Thanks — I'll coordinate times once you confirm availability.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference — High-performance LLM inference for production

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — SOC 2, audit logs, retention (Redwood + Acme Health)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the quick turnaround. That aligns with our conversation. A few clarifying questions before we schedule the technical deep-dive:

1) SOC 2: Is the SOC 2 you're sharing covering the hosted API and the control plane (i.e., Redwood-hosted deployments)? We need confirmation that it covers the runtime components that process PHI.

2) Pen test evidence: can you share a redacted pen-test report (or executive summary) and confirm whether you use a 3rd-party vendor and the date of the last test?

3) Audit logs: does Redwood provide immutable, exportable audit logs with timestamps, actor IDs, and request/response metadata? We'll need to confirm the granularity.

4) Retention: We discussed 7+ years as our preferred retention for certain artifacts. What is Redwood's default retention for audit logs and what are the options for archival to meet 7+ years (S3 cold storage, export, or legal hold)?

5) DPA: we'll have legal review. If you have a standard redline you accept, send that; otherwise expect comments.

For the technical call, Tom Ruiz (cc'd) is our security engineer — he prefers Wed 4/14 2:00–3:00 PM PT. Please confirm and include the dial-in + an agenda (list of endpoints, retention/export demo, and KMS/HSM integration discussion).

Thanks —
Lisa

Lisa Chen
Director of IT Security | Acme Health
lisa.chen@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — SOC 2, audit logs, retention (Redwood + Acme Health)

Thanks Lisa — great, Wed 4/14 2:00–3:00 PM PT works for our team. Confirming the agenda and the artifacts we've attached.

Quick answers to your questions below, and details we'll expand on during the technical call:  

1) SOC 2 scope: The attached "Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf" is our latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the Redwood hosted control plane and inference runtime services. It includes the controls around data handling, access controls, and change management for the hosted environment. If you need a statement of applicability or scoping letter for specific components, Rishi can pull that together.

2) Pen test: We commissioned a 3rd-party pen test with SecureProbe (executive summary included in the attachments). The last full pentest was conducted in 2026-11; we run annual tests and retest critical fixes. We can provide a redacted report under an NDA if required.

3) Audit logs: Redwood provides detailed, exportable audit logs with timestamps, actor identifiers (user id / service principal), request metadata, and action types. Logs are available via API export and we can provide a daily export to your S3 bucket or a secure link for a defined range. We also offer write-once storage for audit logs upon request for higher immutability guarantees.

4) Retention: Default retention for audit logs in hosted deployments is 90 days. Options for long-term retention include:
   - Automated exports to customer-managed S3 (recommended for 7+ year requirements).
   - Cold-archive (nearline) managed by Redwood for multi-year retention (pricing and SLA to be discussed).
   - Legal hold workflow to prevent deletion during an active hold.

We'll bring our infra lead on the call (Neha) to demo the export flow and show how keys and encryption are handled.

5) DPA & legal: Attached redwood_dpa_v1.docx is our standard DPA. If your legal team prefers to start redlines, we can accept comments or propose a quick session to align.

Attachments included (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf — SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where required)
- pen_test_summary_secureprobe_202611.pdf — executive summary of the last pentest
- retention_policy_summary.pdf — short doc outlining default retention and options
- redwood_dpa_v1.docx — DPA template

Call logistics:
- Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027
- Time: 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Dial-in: Zoom link (will send calendar invite)
- Agenda: 1) SOC 2 scope confirmation; 2) audit log export & retention demo; 3) encryption/KMS options; 4) pen-test evidence & next steps for redaction/NDAs; 5) legal DPA timeline.

Next steps from Redwood (owned):
- I'll send calendar invite + Zoom link (Marissa) — by end of day.
- Share a sample logs export (1-week window) and redacted pen-test report under NDA if requested (Rishi/Neha).
- Draft a short mutual action plan (HubSpot link included) for sign-off after technical call (Marissa).

If that looks good I'll send the invite now.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
